concerns.text: Constitution Principle VI mandates reporting 'Fisher's z-transformed correlation deviations' for every generator evaluation. No task in T001–T012 computes or reports a Fisher-z correlation metric; T002/T006/T009 cover only absolute Pearson/Spearman differences and permutation tests, and the metric_results contract has no Fisher-z metric_type. Add a task (or extend T002/T006) computing Fisher's z-transformed correlation deviations per column pair and reporting them in the metric results.
